name: Untere Issalm
beschreibung: The Untere Issalm is located in the Kufstein district of Tyrol, nestled in an alpine pasture landscape at around 1,000 meters above sea level. The building is a former alpine hut that is now operated as a youth hostel, offering simple and functional accommodation. The setting is peaceful and rural—perfect for hikers and groups eager to explore the alpine nature. Guests have access to multi-bed dorms, a communal kitchen, and a small lounge area. The nearest village with grocery shopping facilities is situated down in the valley.
